note: MFP-VI = A_ads (RQ2 min-max with a 0.05 floor) x H_receptor (RQ3 ordinal evidence tier). H_receptor is a min-max rescaling of the PPARalpha docking scores with a 0.20 floor for the weakest compound: FTOH 1.00, PFOA 0.92, GenX 0.46, PFBS 0.20. The ordering agrees with published in-vitro PPARalpha data. D_desorp and P_persist are unresolved, so only the A x H evidence tier is reported.
tier_floor_note: H_receptor is a min-max rescaling of the docking scores; a plain min-max would force the weakest compound (PFBS) to exactly zero, so a 0.20 evidence-tier floor is applied.
